#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
cd /data/project/yuxilab/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/.omo/workspaces/42034e531783f9b79c5071443ee9af879e328987c7b4984468b76405ece34b51/source || exit 1
export CPM_SOURCE_CACHE=/u/yuxihong/.cache/CPM
mkdir -p build/overseer-options/.cmake/api/v1/query || exit 1
: > build/overseer-options/.cmake/api/v1/query/codemodel-v2
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "build", "server": "lair-cpu", "argv": ["cmake", "--preset", "openmp-examples", "-B", "build/overseer-options", "-DSPCRAFT_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON"]}'
if cmake --preset openmp-examples -B build/overseer-options -DSPCRAFT_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON; then :; else
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "build_failed", "server": "lair-cpu"}'
exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "build", "server": "lair-cpu", "argv": ["cmake", "--build", "build/overseer-options", "--target", "bench_ompspmv", "--parallel", "4"]}'
if cmake --build build/overseer-options --target bench_ompspmv --parallel 4; then :; else
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "build_failed", "server": "lair-cpu"}'
exit 1
fi
failures=0
mkdir -p /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261013-025215-48873717376310/0001 || exit 1
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "start", "total": 2, "id": 1, "server": "lair-cpu", "parameters": {"dataset": "/u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/gupta3/gupta3.mtx", "threads": 4, "method": "openmp-double"}, "choices": {"dataset": "gupta3", "threads": "4", "method": "openmp-double"}}'
env OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 CPM_SOURCE_CACHE=/u/yuxihong/.cache/CPM srun --nodes=1 --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=4 /data/project/yuxilab/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/.omo/workspaces/42034e531783f9b79c5071443ee9af879e328987c7b4984468b76405ece34b51/source/build/overseer-options/bin/bench_ompspmv --matrix /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/gupta3/gupta3.mtx --threads 4 --index int32 --offset int32 --iterations 5 --max-time 0.05 --output /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261013-025215-48873717376310/0001/result.json --precision double 2>&1 | tee /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261013-025215-48873717376310/0001/output.log
code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
printf '%s%s%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "finish", "id": 1, "server": "lair-cpu", "parameters": {"dataset": "/u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/gupta3/gupta3.mtx", "threads": 4, "method": "openmp-double"}, "choices": {"dataset": "gupta3", "threads": "4", "method": "openmp-double"}, "exit_code": ' "$code" '}'
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then failures=$((failures+1)); fi
mkdir -p /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261013-025215-48873717376310/0002 || exit 1
printf '%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "start", "total": 2, "id": 2, "server": "lair-cpu", "parameters": {"dataset": "/u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/pdb1HYS/pdb1HYS.mtx", "threads": 4, "method": "openmp-double"}, "choices": {"dataset": "pdb1HYS", "threads": "4", "method": "openmp-double"}}'
env OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 CPM_SOURCE_CACHE=/u/yuxihong/.cache/CPM srun --nodes=1 --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=4 /data/project/yuxilab/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/.omo/workspaces/42034e531783f9b79c5071443ee9af879e328987c7b4984468b76405ece34b51/source/build/overseer-options/bin/bench_ompspmv --matrix /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/pdb1HYS/pdb1HYS.mtx --threads 4 --index int32 --offset int32 --iterations 5 --max-time 0.05 --output /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261013-025215-48873717376310/0002/result.json --precision double 2>&1 | tee /u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/results/overseer/20261013-025215-48873717376310/0002/output.log
code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
printf '%s%s%s\n' '@@OVERSEER {"event": "finish", "id": 2, "server": "lair-cpu", "parameters": {"dataset": "/u/yuxihong/workspace/omo-spcraft/dataset/output/pdb1HYS/pdb1HYS.mtx", "threads": 4, "method": "openmp-double"}, "choices": {"dataset": "pdb1HYS", "threads": "4", "method": "openmp-double"}, "exit_code": ' "$code" '}'
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then failures=$((failures+1)); fi
[ "$failures" -eq 0 ]
